import polars as pl

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        order_id=pl.col("order_no").str.to_uppercase(),
        line_no=pl.col("items.line").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        sold_at=pl.col("created").str.strptime(pl.Datetime("us"), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", strict=False),
        store=pl.col("@export.store").str.to_uppercase(),
        sku=pl.col("items.sku").str.to_uppercase(),
        qty=pl.col("items.qty").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        unit_price=pl.col("items.price").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        discount=pl.col("items.discount").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        line_total=pl.col("items.total").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
    )
